spec_match.rationale: Calls document.spellCheckCustomDictionary.addWords/removeWords with a real glossary beside a spellcheck-enabled field, and journals the exact call.

interactive.rationale: Chip remove buttons, add-term input, Add/Remove/Reset and the disable toggle all update the glossary, counters and journal.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The lede switches on the same document.spellCheckCustomDictionary probe the journal uses: with the flag it says the real addWords() call is made.

edge_cases.rationale: Case-mismatch counter exists; no demonstration of words with spaces/punctuation (e.g. PROJ-1841) being tokenised differently by the checker.

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/<id> in the see-also block plus the spec/explainer.

conformance.rationale: Unflagged: 2 PASS / 5 FAIL (feature is "experimental" in runtime_enabled_features.json5); with --enable-blink-features=SpellCheckCustomDictionaryAPI: 7/7 PASS, including the write-only and [SameObject] contracts.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Playwright headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 against a local server on :3109 (chrome-devtools-mcp not available to this pass): flagged run: "Sent 7 terms" with a real addWords call journalled; unflagged run journals the call as not made; console clean; not a chrome-devtools-mcp/Canary pass, and no accessibility-tree inspection.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry is loaded and the page records named assertions for its main measurement; no unexpected errors seen.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; chip and button pairs readable.

accessibility.rationale: Chip remove buttons measure 44x44 at 360px (were 17x20), keep their 'Remove <term> from the glossary' names, have a visible focus ring, and Enter on a focused chip button removes the term (7 -> 6 verified).

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No overflow at 360px, but the 17×20px chip remove buttons are not usable touch targets.
